meta.title: Free mockup · Cosmic Studio | Geneva & Annecy
meta.description: Get a free mockup of your future website: pick a colour direction, tell us what you have in mind, and receive a first design by email. No commitment.

freeMockup.title: See your site before you decide
freeMockup.intro: Tell us where you stand today and the mood you have in mind. You get a mockup of your future website — free, and with nothing to commit to.

brief.title: You send the essentials
brief.description: Your email, the colour direction you like if you have one, and your current website if you have one.

design.title: We design a mockup
design.description: A first look at your home page, built from what you described.

deliver.title: You decide, calmly
deliver.description: The mockup lands in your inbox. If it is not for you, it stops there.

freeMockup.privacy_notice: Your email and your message are used only to prepare and send your mockup.

form.heading: Request your mockup
form.lead: One email — everything else is optional.
form.wishes_placeholder: The pages you need, what you like, what you would rather avoid…
form.success_message: Thank you — we will come back to you by email with your mockup.
form.error_message: Your request could not be sent. Please try again in a moment.
form.retry_later_message: Your request could not be sent right now. Please try again later.
form.plan_attached: The results of your pricing simulation will be included with your request.

validation.email_invalid: Please enter a valid email address.
validation.url_invalid: Please enter a valid website address, for example my-site.com.
validation.wishes_too_long: Please keep your message under 500 characters.
